goal: Save enough, by the planned move date, to pay the deposit, the van hire and the overlapping rent for a move to another city, and keep the plan up to date as the figures change.

in: The one-off cost of the move: the deposit on the new home, the van hire and a period of months when rent is paid on both homes
Any other one-off moving costs the person lists, such as cleaning or packing materials
How much to put aside each month to have that sum by the move date
How many months the current monthly saving would take, if the move date is not fixed
Re-running the plan as prices, savings and the move date change
out: Choosing the new home, the city or the van company
Tax, benefits or any advice on products
Running costs of the new home after the move

glossary.definition: Money set aside over a period of time for a known future expense. In personal budgeting it is a category you pay into regularly for a planned cost.
Fixed expenses do not change from month to month. Variable expenses can change each month depending on your usage.
glossary.person_says: rent is the same every month, the van price depends on the days

glossary.definition: A cash reserve set aside specifically for unplanned expenses or financial emergencies.
glossary.person_says: the rainy day money I do not want to touch

glossary.definition: The amount in an account at the start of a period. The closing balance of one period is carried forward as the opening balance of the next.
glossary.person_says: what I have saved so far

particulars.what: For some months the person pays rent on the old home and on the new one at the same time.
particulars.handling: Count the overlap as a number of months at the old home's monthly rent. It is a cost of the move, not part of the normal monthly spending.

particulars.what: The deposit paid on the old home comes back only after the person has left it.
particulars.handling: Do not count that refund as money available before the move. If it arrives later it can be entered as savings then.

particulars.what: The van price depends on the number of days and the distance, so it may change.
particulars.handling: Enter the best quote as a single amount and update it when a new quote comes in.

particulars.what: The person keeps an emergency fund and does not want to use it for the move.
particulars.handling: Leave the emergency fund out of the savings so far. Only money put aside for the move counts.

particulars.what: The move date may shift by a month or two.
particulars.handling: Plan with the months left until the date now, and run the plan again, with the new number of months, when the date changes.

inputs.name: Deposit
inputs.description: The deposit asked for the new home, paid before the move.

inputs.name: Van hire
inputs.description: The quoted price of the van for the move.

inputs.name: Monthly rent of the old home
inputs.description: What the old home costs each month, which is paid during the overlap.

inputs.name: Months of overlapping rent
inputs.description: How many months rent is paid on both homes.

inputs.name: Other one-off costs
inputs.description: Any other costs of the move that are paid once, each with a name and an amount. May be none.

inputs.name: Savings so far
inputs.description: The money already put aside for the move, not counting the emergency fund.

inputs.name: Months until the move
inputs.description: How many months are left to save before the move.

inputs.name: Monthly amount you can save
inputs.description: What the person can put aside for the move each month.

process.name: Work out the upfront cost of the move
process.formula: upfront cost = deposit + van hire + (months of overlapping rent x monthly rent of the old home) + the sum of any other one-off costs
needs: Monthly rent of the old home
process.produces: The total sum needed before the move
process.cadence: when a price or the overlap changes

process.name: Work out the monthly saving needed to reach the cost by the move date
process.formula: monthly saving needed = (upfront cost - savings so far) / months until the move; 0 if the savings already cover the cost
process.produces: The amount to put aside each month to have the upfront cost by the move date

process.name: Work out how many months the current monthly saving would take
process.formula: months needed = (upfront cost - savings so far) / monthly amount you can save, rounded up to a whole month; 0 if the savings already cover the cost
process.produces: The number of months until the savings would cover the upfront cost

process.name: Decide whether to keep the move date or move it
process.produces: A plain view of whether the move date is realistic at the current saving, and what to change first: the date, the van, the overlap or the saving

definition_of_done: The person can see the total sum needed before the move and what each part of it is.
The person knows how much to put aside each month to have it by the move date, or how many months their current saving would take.
The plan is run again whenever a price, the savings or the move date changes.
open_questions: How many months will rent be paid on both homes?
Does the new landlord accept the deposit in parts, or all at once?
Is there a cheaper van date, for example in the middle of the week?
